description: We are a team passionate about space exploration, health science, and technology. Our goal is to develop health monitoring software for astronauts on space missions to detect potential health risks and improve their safety. We aim to combine creativity, innovation, and teamwork to create a practical solution that supports the future of space exploration.
summary:
Astronaut Health Care is a website designed to monitor and analyze astronauts’ health in three key areas: heart health, sleep, and nutrition. It also provides notifications when health abnormalities are detected. The collected data can be used to improve healthcare management and develop healthier lifestyle plans, such as organizing sleep schedules, meal plans, exercise routines, and work schedules.

This website helps astronauts manage their time more effectively, reduce problems caused by insufficient rest, and maintain good health while carrying out missions in space. Furthermore, the concept can also be adapted and applied to everyday life on Earth to help people manage their daily schedules and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
details:
Project Details – Astronaut Health Care

Team Nextopia

Astronaut Health Care is a web-based health monitoring system designed to help astronauts monitor and manage their health during space missions. It focuses on three main areas: cardiovascular health, sleep, and nutrition.

The system allows astronauts to record daily health data, view health information through a dashboard, track health trends, receive alerts for potential abnormalities, and get personalized sleep and nutritional recommendations.

Benefits and Intended Impact: The project aims to reduce health risks, promote healthy lifestyles, and help astronauts maintain their well-being during long-duration space missions. It can also be adapted for everyday health monitoring on Earth.

Tools and Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Claude AI, Gemini AI, and Grok AI. The prototype uses manually entered health data, with medical device integration planned for future development.

Creativity and Innovation: It combines cardiovascular monitoring, sleep tracking, and nutrition management in one platform, with personalized recommendations based on individual health information.

Factors Considered: Space environmental conditions, microgravity, sleep patterns, nutritional needs, individual health conditions, and user-friendly design.
